display.title: Rosh Hashanah: The World's Birthday and Crowning Hashem as King
display.summary_short: Rosh Hashanah is the world's birthday: Uncle Yossi explains how Hashem renews the world and how our prayers and the shofar crown Him as King.
display.summary_long: A short Rosh Hashanah talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, on the eve of 5751. Uncle Yossi explains that Rosh Hashanah is a birthday for the whole world: just as Hashem created the world from nothing, every Rosh Hashanah He renews it, and renews our neshamah with fresh strength for Torah and mitzvos, a healthy soul in a healthy body, as the Alter Rebbe said. When Adam, the first man, proclaimed Hashem King, Hashem had great pleasure and wished to keep the world going. So too, when we crown Hashem as King with the prayers of the machzor and the sounding of the shofar, He blesses us for the whole year. Children are urged to come to shul on time on both days to hear the shofar, and to look forward to the great shofar of Moshiach and next year in Yerushalayim.
display.lesson: On Rosh Hashanah we crown Hashem as our King; be in shul to hear the shofar.
